newsitem.title: USA: CBOT old crop soybeans tumble in fast trade.
newsitem.headline: CBOT old crop soybeans tumble in fast trade.

text.p: CBOT old crop soybean futures tumbled in fast trade as funds hammered the July contract, pit sources said.
Nearby soymeal futures also slid, taking cues from soybeans.
Trade sources said Refco Inc sold at least one million bushels July. Prudential Securities was also said to be a seller.

Pit sources said rumors continued to circulate that a commercial firm planned to deliver soybeans against the July contract. No soybeans have been posted yet and CBOT reported early Wednesday that a mere 10,000 bushels of soybeans were registered for delivery.
At 1033 CDT, soybeans were down nine cents per bushel to up five with July down nine at $7.23 a bushel. Soymeal was off $2.40 per ton to up $1.20 with July down $2.40 at $241.80.
